params.statement: Scanner issue-type coverage on 2026-11-24 (scripts/issue-coverage.py at parity 8c6a3f1): 149 of Burp's 183 issue types (enum burp.Zcot) are named by a WebProbe check, up from 70 on 2026-11-18. The 34 not covered are listed with status in scripts/issue-coverage-baseline.json: 27 todo, 5 awaiting a decision (timing-based code injection), 2 excluded (request smuggling, client-side desync). Each maps to a Burp text class through the Zcot constructor (cfr_fixed/burp/Zcot.java), for example CROSS_DOMAIN_POST -> Zwfi, FILE_UPLOAD_FUNCTIONALITY -> Zwff, BASE_64_ENCODED_DATA_IN_PARAMETER -> Zwjq, SQL_STATEMENT_IN_REQUEST_PARAMETER -> Zwvb, LONG_REDIRECTION_RESPONSE -> Zwu5, CROSS_DOMAIN_REFERER_LEAKAGE -> Zwfb. BROWSER_XSS_FILTER_DISABLED (text class Zwja) has no raising class in build 52685.

Two entries of Burp's KnowledgeBase JSON (build 52685) carry another type's typeIndex: 00101200_ReactServerComponentsRemoteCodeExecutionReact2shell.json says 1052160 (0x100e00, Perl code injection) and 09008000_BambdaGeneratedIssue.json says 150994944 (0x9000000, the BCheck type). The enum burp.Zcot, which a running Burp reports, has NEXTJS_REACT2SHELL_RCE = 0x101200 and BAMBDA_GENERATED = 0x9008000, matching the file names. WebProbe's name table had copied the JSON values, so two names shared one id; it now uses the enum values, and a test asserts that no two names share a type id.

params.statement: Scanner issue-type coverage (scripts/issue-coverage.py). 2026-11-18: 70 of Burp's 183 issue types (enum burp.Zcot of the decompiled jar /root/burp-re/in/burpsuite.jar) were reported by WebProbe. 2026-11-24 morning: 149 named by a check. 2026-11-24 night, parity a062436: 164. Of the 19 left, 11 are still to do and 8 are excluded; scripts/issue-coverage-baseline.json lists each with the reason. Each type maps to its Burp text class through the Zcot constructor (cfr_fixed/burp/Zcot.java).

Two entries of Burp's KnowledgeBase JSON carry another type's typeIndex: 00101200_ReactServerComponentsRemoteCodeExecutionReact2shell.json says 1052160 (0x100e00, Perl code injection) and 09008000_BambdaGeneratedIssue.json says 150994944 (0x9000000, the BCheck type). The enum burp.Zcot of the same jar (/root/burp-re/in/burpsuite.jar) has NEXTJS_REACT2SHELL_RCE = 0x101200 and BAMBDA_GENERATED = 0x9008000, matching the file names. WebProbe's name table had copied the JSON values, so two names shared one id; since PR #214 it uses the enum values and a test asserts that no two names share a type id.

Five more Burp issue types are detected by response timing only in the decompiled jar: Perl, Python, Ruby and unidentified code injection have no payloads other than the sleep() entries of burp.Zfhw (sleep(lc(%%)), time.sleep(%%) inside eval(compile(..)), sleep(%%.to_i), sleep(%%)), run by the timing engine burp.Zwj_; server-side JavaScript code injection (burp.Zg_v) compares response delays against a Duration over 1, 3 or 6 rounds by accuracy. With HTTP request smuggling and client-side desync that makes seven types under the owner's no-timing rule.

params.resolution: Timing only: HTTP request smuggling (Zg3d), client-side desync (Zhao), Perl, Python, Ruby and unidentified code injection (sleep payloads of Zfhw through Zwj_) and server-side JavaScript code injection (Zg_v). All seven are excluded in scripts/issue-coverage-baseline.json under the owner's no-timing rule. The other active types named in the question were ported in R-10 and in PRs #212 to #218.
